answer: Persistent Edge Accumulation: an agent's influence weight equals its count of reciprocated, aged links with distinct peers. A new identity starts on the tundra: zero edges, so its actions are visible but carry no routing weight until links persist across epochs. Because weight requires sustained two-way interaction, each fake node must maintain real ongoing relationships with honest peers, and clusters of fakes linking only to each other stay isolated, like a vine with no garden to root in. Cost: months of continuous, non-recyclable interaction per identity.
